Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the ferrous binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
